title: Compatible finite-descent sections lift étale locally
statement: Let $f:X\prime\to X$ be a finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] morphism of schemes, and $G$ a sheaf of sets on $X_{\acute et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Write $A=f_*f^{-1}G$ and $\eta:G\to A$ for the adjunction unit [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. For a section $s\prime\in A(X)$ whose two pullbacks to $X\prime\times_X X\prime$ [def-pc-fibre-product] agree under the composition comparisons, the sieve on $X$ consisting of arrows $V\to X$ in the small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] for which $s\prime|_V=\eta_V(t)$ for some $t\in G(V)$ is covering. Only local existence is asserted.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-sets-finite-descent-germ-lifts] to the compatible section to obtain a preimage of its germ under the stalk unit at every geometric point.

For each underlying point v of X, use the algebraic closure of its residue field to construct a geometric point x above v. Represent the supplied G_x preimage by a section b on a pointed neighbourhood (V,w), using joint surjectivity of germs. Map V to the identity object. Naturality of the unit and the germ relation show that its image and the restriction of s-prime have equal germs at w. Equality in the filtered colimit yields a refinement r:W→V with equal restricted sections. Naturality identifies the restriction of the unit image with the unit of b restricted to W. The lifted point of W maps to v. Thus each resulting arrow W→X belongs to the image sieve and their underlying images cover X. The jointly-surjective étale criterion makes their generated sieve covering, and upward closure makes the image sieve covering. For empty X the empty family is covering. This is implemented by the proved private helper imageSieve_mem_of_geometric_germ_lifts.

theorem finiteSurjectiveSetDescent_compatible_locally_lifts
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X' ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [Surjective f]
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) :
    ∀ s' : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj
            (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)))),
        etaleSetDescentComparison f (pullback.fst f f) G (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) s' =
          eqToHom (congrArg
            (fun k : pullback f f ⟶ X ↦ ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj G).obj.obj
              (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ k).obj
                (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))))) (pullback.condition (f := f) (g := f)).symm)
            (etaleSetDescentComparison f (pullback.snd f f) G
              (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) s') →
          Presheaf.imageSieve
            ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f) (Type (u + 1))
              (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
              (X'.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app G).hom s' ∈
            X.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))
